# OpenCC browser converter

`opencc-1.4.2.js` is the unmodified `dist/umd/full.js` from the official npm package `opencc-js@1.4.2`:

https://registry.npmjs.org/opencc-js/-/opencc-js-1.4.2.tgz

The package integrity is checked against npm's SHA-512 distribution record before extraction. Original license files accompany this copy. The browser loads this repository-local file; it does not depend on a third-party CDN.

Conversion is only a reading/display transformation. It never rewrites the archived original texts, their hashes, ZIP packages, or PAR2 recovery files. Downloading the simplified TXT yields the converted reading text, while downloading the original package yields the unchanged archival bytes.
